# E0715: a lens uses a construct the Cap'n Proto compiler cannot carry

A compiled lineage runs a program for each lens: the lens rewritten in the
forms the lens language proves total, which the compiled artifact carries for
an engine to run. A lens that uses a construct those programs do not carry
yet, here a list literal inside an expression, binds and translates in Go, but
has nothing to run once compiled, so the lineage does not compile.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				n: int8
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			a: v0_0.a
			n: len([v0_0.a])
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v1_0.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0715]: lens 0.0->1.0 uses a construct the Cap'n Proto compiler cannot carry
  --> lineage.cue:20:2
   |
20 |     "0.0->1.0": {
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^
   |
   = note: lens 0.0->1.0 uses a construct the compiled lens programs do not carry yet: [v0_0.a] is not an expression the IR carries (Cap'n Proto rule lens-no-program)
   = help: write the lens in the forms the lens language proves
```
